timeline.title: Super Enterprises Founded
timeline.description: Our journey began in Mumbai as Super Enterprises, a small print shop built on precision and a promise to never miss a deadline.

timeline.title: Reborn as Pujara Print N Pack
timeline.description: As demand grew beyond print into packaging and branding, we relaunched as Pujara Print N Pack with new machinery and a wider service range.

timeline.title: Mumbai's Trusted Print & Packaging Partner
timeline.description: Today we serve thousands of businesses with offset & digital print, corporate gifting, packaging, signage and more, backed by a 99.5% on-time delivery record.

coreValues.title: Quality Standards
coreValues.description: Every job is checked against strict quality benchmarks before it leaves our facility, from proof to final delivery.
coreValues.reveal: Colour-accurate proofing, premium stock and multi-point checks on every single order.

coreValues.title: Integrity
coreValues.description: Transparent pricing, honest timelines and no surprises. What we commit to is what we deliver.
coreValues.reveal: Clear quotes, honest turnaround estimates, and accountability when things need to change.

coreValues.title: Customer Service
coreValues.description: A dedicated team that stays with your order from enquiry to doorstep, ready to solve problems fast.
coreValues.reveal: Responsive support, proactive updates, and a single point of contact for every project.
